items.name: tokens
items.title: ai2 Tokens
items.description: ai2 extension tokens: tone colors (brand, success, warning, danger, info + soft pairs), surface-2/3 and motion variables. Required by every ai2 component; installed automatically as a dependency.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Button with a full variant x tone x size matrix: 5 variants (solid, soft, outline, ghost, link), 6 tones (neutral, brand, success, warning, danger, info), 10 sizes (xs-xl plus square icon-xs through icon-xl for icon-only buttons), plus isLoading and asChild. Every tone is driven by ai2 semantic tokens.
items.docs: Use tone for semantic intent (brand for primary product actions, danger for destructive) and variant for visual weight. isLoading disables the button and shows a spinner.

items.name: theme-indigo
items.title: ai2 Indigo
items.description: Indigo brand theme for ai2: recolors the brand tone channel (solid + soft pairs) in light and dark mode. Install on top of any ai2 setup; every component using tone=brand follows automatically.

items.name: glass
items.title: Glass
items.description: Floating surface treatments: glass.overlay (translucent + blur, for tooltips/dropdowns), glass.frosted (heavier blur + deep layered shadow, for modals), glass.solid (opaque), plus shadow.default and shadow.max elevation tokens. Class-string helpers composed with cn(); backgrounds wired to ai2 tokens so glass follows any theme in both modes. Inspired by the Delphi glass system.
items.docs: Use glass.* only when floating UI sits over VARIED content. Never stack glass on glass (use shadow.default + glass.solid for lower layers). Use shadow.max on exactly one surface per page (the primary prompt input or sticky bar).

items.name: primitives
items.title: Primitives
items.description: Headless primitive adapter: the single entry point every ai2 component imports its unstyled behaviour from. Components never import the primitive library directly, so the provider is swapped in one file instead of thirty. Re-exports the twenty-four Radix UI namespaces the system uses (Dialog, Popover, Select, Tabs, Tooltip, Menu, and the rest). Components with no cross-library equivalent, such as Command, Toast, Drawer, Calendar, OTP input, Carousel and Resizable, keep their own dependency on purpose.
items.docs: Swap the provider here, not in components. Anything without a cross-library equivalent stays out of this file so the surface does not promise a swap it cannot deliver.

items.name: primitives-base
items.title: Primitives (Base UI)
items.description: The second provider behind the ai2 primitive adapter: the same surface as @ai2/primitives, bound to Base UI instead of Radix. A pro block imports the adapter, not the library, so the same block source runs on either one. Anatomy differences are absorbed here (Base UI wraps the slider track in a Control part and calls the filled part Indicator, and it renders a native range input inside the thumb, so focus styling is mirrored from focus-visible to focus-within). Primitives with no Base UI counterpart are deliberately left out rather than silently falling back to Radix.
items.docs: Install this instead of @ai2/primitives when you want the block to run on Base UI. Nothing else in the block changes.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Card surface with 4 variants (outline, elevated, soft, glass) and 3 inset scales (sm, md, lg) that pad header, content and footer together. Parts: Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardAction, CardContent, CardFooter.
items.docs: Use variant for surface depth (elevated for emphasis, soft for nested surfaces, glass over imagery) and inset to scale internal padding consistently across all parts. The glass variant derives from the @ai2/glass surface treatments.

items.name: file-input
items.title: File Input
items.description: Styled file picker: hidden native input under a custom surface with a leading icon (lucide or remixicon), placeholder or selected file name, multiple-file count and an optional clear button. Follows the Input contract: 3 variants (outline, soft, ghost), 3 sizes (sm, md, lg), 3 tones (neutral, success, danger). States: empty, selected, disabled, invalid via aria-invalid.
items.docs: Use in place of a bare input[type=file]. The icon prop swaps the paperclip; clearable={false} hides the clear button. Reads files from the native change event, so existing form handling keeps working.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Composable input shell: InputGroup carries the field appearance with 3 variants (outline, soft, ghost), 3 sizes (sm, md, lg) and 3 tones (neutral, success, danger); InputGroupInput/InputGroupTextarea render transparent controls inside; InputGroupAddon places icons, text or buttons at inline-start, inline-end, block-start or block-end; InputGroupText and InputGroupButton for addon content.
items.docs: Use for icons or actions inside a text field: leading search icon, trailing clear button, kbd hints, prefixes like https://. Focus and invalid state lift from the inner control to the group border. Use FileInput for file uploads instead.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Text input with 3 variants (outline, soft, ghost), 3 sizes (sm, md, lg) and 3 tones (neutral, success, danger) for validation states via border and focus ring color. Invalid state also via aria-invalid.
items.docs: Set aria-invalid on validation errors; the destructive ring style is built in. Use variant=soft on dense forms and filled surfaces.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Auto-growing textarea (field-sizing-content) with 3 variants (outline, soft, ghost), 3 sizes (sm, md, lg) and 3 tones (neutral, success, danger) matching Input. Invalid state also via aria-invalid.
items.docs: Shares variant language with Input so forms stay consistent. It grows with content by default via field-sizing.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Accessible form label built on radix-ui Label with 2 sizes (sm, md). Auto-dims when the associated control is disabled.
items.docs: Pair with any form control via htmlFor. Handles peer-disabled and group-data-disabled dimming automatically.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox on radix-ui with 4 tones (neutral, brand, success, danger) and 3 sizes (sm, md, lg). Invalid state via aria-invalid.
items.docs: tone sets the checked fill color. Use inside a Label for a clickable row.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Radio group + item on radix-ui with 4 tones and 3 sizes. Exports RadioGroup and RadioGroupItem.
items.docs: Wrap RadioGroupItem elements in RadioGroup and give each item a value. tone/size are set per item.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Toggle switch on radix-ui with 4 tones (neutral, brand, success, danger) and 3 sizes (sm, md, lg). Thumb travel and easing use ai2 motion tokens.
items.docs: tone sets the checked track color. Use for instant-apply settings; use Checkbox for form submission.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Badge with a variant x tone x size matrix: 3 variants (solid, soft, outline), 6 tones, 3 sizes (sm, md, lg). Icons work with both lucide svg and remixicon i children. Supports asChild for links.
items.docs: Use soft variant for status pills, solid for counts, outline for subtle tags. tone carries the semantic meaning.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Avatar on radix-ui with 5 sizes (xs-xl) and 2 shapes (circle, rounded), plus AvatarGroup for overlapping stacks with an optional max that collapses the rest into a +N tile. Exports Avatar, AvatarImage, AvatarFallback, AvatarGroup.
items.docs: AvatarFallback renders while the image loads or if it fails. Fallback text is sized automatically per avatar size.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Progress bar on radix-ui with 6 tones (neutral, brand, success, warning, danger, info) and 3 sizes. Fill animates using ai2 motion tokens.
items.docs: Pass value 0-100. tone conveys status (success for complete, danger for over-quota).

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholder on the ai2 surface-3 token with 3 shapes (line, circle, rect) and 2 animations (pulse, none). Style dimensions via className.
items.docs: Compose multiple Skeletons to mirror the shape of the content that is loading.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Loading spinner (lucide) with 3 tones (current, brand, muted) and 4 sizes (sm-xl). Has role=status and an aria-label.
items.docs: tone=current inherits text color, so it matches whatever context it sits in (e.g. inside a Button).

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Horizontal or vertical divider on radix-ui with 2 variants (solid, dashed) and an optional centered label that renders a two-line divider with text (e.g. OR). Decorative by default with correct aria semantics when not.
items.docs: Set orientation=vertical inside a flex row; give the row a height for the divider to show.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Keyboard key hint styled with the ai2 mono font and surface tokens. Use for shortcuts and command hints.
items.docs: Combine multiple Kbd elements for chords, e.g. Ctrl + K.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Form field composition: Field, FieldControl, FieldLabel, FieldDescription, FieldError. Auto-wires accessibility: FieldControl (a Slot around any control) receives a generated id, aria-describedby pointing at the description and error, and aria-invalid; the label targets the control automatically. invalid/disabled props drive data attributes, label color and dimming. orientation switches vertical (default) and horizontal (label-left, e.g. switch rows).
items.docs: Wrap the control in FieldControl to get id/aria-describedby/aria-invalid wiring for free. FieldError renders nothing when empty, so you can bind it directly to a form library's error string; a present error marks the whole field invalid.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs on radix-ui with 3 variants (solid segmented, line underline, pill) and 2 sizes (sm, md). Variant and size flow from TabsList to every trigger via context. Exports Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent.
items.docs: Set variant on TabsList; triggers inherit it via context. Use line for docs-style pages, pill for compact filters.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Accordion on radix-ui with 3 variants (default divided rows, separated cards, outline boxed) plus animated open/close (ai2 motion tokens) and a rotating chevron. Variant flows from Accordion to every item via context. Exports Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent.
items.docs: Pass type=single collapsible for FAQ, type=multiple for settings panels. Height animation uses the radix content-height variable.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Alert with a variant x tone matrix: 2 variants (soft, outline) x 6 tones. Optional leading icon, AlertTitle and AlertDescription. role=alert.
items.docs: Place an icon as the first child; the grid layout indents the title/description automatically. tone carries the semantic meaning.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Tooltip on radix-ui with portal, arrow, directional slide/zoom animations and 2 content sizes (sm, md). Tooltip wraps its own Provider, so a single import works out of the box.
items.docs: Wrap the trigger with TooltipTrigger asChild to attach to any element. Content renders in a portal so it escapes overflow-hidden parents.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Accessible breadcrumb (nav + ordered list) with link, current page, separator and ellipsis parts. Semantic aria-current on the active page.
items.docs: Use BreadcrumbPage for the current page (not a link) and BreadcrumbEllipsis to collapse long trails.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal dialog on radix-ui with portal, overlay, focus trap, fade/zoom animations and 5 content sizes (sm, md, lg, xl, full) that cap the width from the sm breakpoint up while staying full width minus a margin on mobile. Exports Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogFooter, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogClose.
items.docs: showClose defaults to true. Always include DialogTitle (visually hidden with sr-only if needed) for accessibility.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Slide-in panel on radix-ui Dialog with 4 sides (right, left, top, bottom), 3 sizes (sm, md, lg) that set the panel width for the left/right sides, and directional slide animations using ai2 motion tokens.
items.docs: Set side on SheetContent. Use for navigation drawers (left/right) and mobile filters (bottom).

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Popover on radix-ui with portal, directional slide/zoom animations, 3 content sizes (sm, md, lg) and an optional anchor. Exports Popover, PopoverTrigger, PopoverContent, PopoverAnchor.
items.docs: Content renders in a portal so it escapes overflow-hidden. Use PopoverAnchor to detach the position from the trigger.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Full dropdown menu on radix-ui: items (default + danger variant), checkbox items, radio group, submenus, labels, separators and shortcuts. Keyboard navigable.
items.docs: Use variant=danger on destructive items. Submenus, checkbox and radio items handle their own indicators.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Select on radix-ui. Trigger follows the Input contract: 3 variants (outline, soft, ghost), 3 sizes (sm, md, lg), 3 tones (neutral, success, danger). Grouped items, labels, separators, scroll buttons, checkmark indicator; popper positioned with matching width.
items.docs: Pair SelectTrigger + SelectValue with SelectContent > SelectItem. size is set on SelectTrigger.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Command palette (cmdk) with fuzzy search, groups, items, shortcuts and a CommandDialog wrapper for a ⌘K experience.
items.docs: Use CommandDialog for a global ⌘K palette; bind it to a keydown listener. Plain Command works inline (e.g. inside a Popover combobox).

items.name: sonner
items.title: Toast (Sonner)
items.description: Toast notifications via sonner, themed with ai2 tokens and synced to next-themes. Drop the Toaster once in your root layout, then call toast() anywhere.
items.docs: Render <Toaster /> once near the root. Import { toast } from 'sonner' to trigger notifications from anywhere.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Composable table primitives (Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell, TableCaption) with hover rows, selected state and horizontal scroll. Table takes density (compact, comfortable, relaxed) and variant (line, striped, outline), both flowing to rows and cells via context.
items.docs: Wrap in your own data logic (e.g. TanStack Table) or use directly. The container handles overflow-x for wide tables.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Confirmation dialog on radix-ui AlertDialog for destructive or irreversible actions. Action button defaults to the danger tone; cancel is focused first per WAI-ARIA.
items.docs: Use for destructive confirmations (delete, revoke). Unlike Dialog it has no close X and cannot be dismissed by clicking outside.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: Two-state toggle button on radix-ui with 2 variants (default, outline), 3 sizes and 2 tones (neutral, brand). Pressed state uses the accent token (neutral) or brand-soft (brand).
items.docs: Use for on/off formatting controls (bold, italic). For groups use toggle-group.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: Single or multiple selection toggle group on radix-ui. Inherits variant/size/tone from the group via context; outline variant renders as a segmented control.
items.docs: Set type=single or type=multiple on ToggleGroup. variant=outline joins items into a segmented control.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Accessible pagination nav (previous/next, page links, ellipsis) styled with ai2 button variants. Current page gets aria-current.
items.docs: Render your page numbers into PaginationLink and set isActive on the current one. Works with any router link via asChild patterns.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Searchable single-select built from Popover + Command. Trigger follows the Input contract: 3 variants (outline, soft, ghost), 3 sizes (sm, md, lg), 3 tones (neutral, success, danger). Controlled or uncontrolled via value/defaultValue and onValueChange; options as {value, label} pairs.
items.docs: Pass options as an array of {value, label, disabled?}. Selecting the active option again clears the value.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Range slider on radix-ui with 4 tones (neutral, brand, success, danger) coloring the range and thumb, and 3 sizes (sm, md, lg) for the track and thumb. Supports single and multi-thumb, horizontal and vertical.
items.docs: Pass value/defaultValue as an array; the number of thumbs follows its length. tone conveys intent (brand for primary controls, danger for destructive ranges).

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Custom cross-browser scroll container on radix-ui with a thin token-colored scrollbar. Exports ScrollArea and ScrollBar (vertical or horizontal orientation).
items.docs: Give the ScrollArea a fixed height (or max-height) so its content can overflow. Add a horizontal ScrollBar inside for two-axis scrolling.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: Rich hover preview on radix-ui with portal, directional slide/zoom animations and 3 content sizes (sm, md, lg). Exports HoverCard, HoverCardTrigger, HoverCardContent.
items.docs: Use for non-essential preview content shown on hover (user cards, link previews). For click-triggered content use Popover, for tap-friendly hints use Tooltip.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Single expand/collapse region on radix-ui. Exports Collapsible, CollapsibleTrigger, CollapsibleContent. Unstyled by design so it composes into any layout.
items.docs: Use for a single show/hide toggle (a filter panel, a see-more block). For a set of mutually exclusive panels use Accordion.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button Group
items.description: Joins buttons, inputs and selects into a single segmented control on horizontal or vertical orientation, collapsing inner radii and borders. Exports ButtonGroup, ButtonGroupText, ButtonGroupSeparator.
items.docs: Wrap ai2 Buttons (and optionally Input, Select, ButtonGroupText) to fuse them into one control. ButtonGroupSeparator draws a divider between segments.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: Empty-state placeholder: Empty wrapper with EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia (default or icon variant), EmptyTitle, EmptyDescription and EmptyContent for actions. Centered, balanced text, dashed-border ready.
items.docs: Use for no-data, no-results and first-run states. EmptyMedia variant=icon frames a lucide or remixicon glyph; put a Button or link inside EmptyContent.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: List/row primitive with 3 variants (default, outline, muted) and 2 sizes (default, sm). Parts: Item, ItemGroup, ItemMedia (default/icon/image), ItemContent, ItemTitle, ItemDescription, ItemActions, ItemHeader, ItemFooter, ItemSeparator. asChild renders the row as a link.
items.docs: Compose settings rows, file lists and notification items. ItemMedia icon/image variants frame leading content; ItemActions holds trailing buttons. Group with ItemGroup + ItemSeparator.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Draggable drawer on vaul with 4 directions (top, right, bottom, left), a drag handle on the bottom variant, overlay and snap behavior. Exports Drawer, DrawerTrigger, DrawerContent, DrawerHeader, DrawerFooter, DrawerTitle, DrawerDescription, DrawerClose, DrawerOverlay, DrawerPortal.
items.docs: Use for mobile bottom sheets and touch-friendly panels with drag-to-dismiss. For a plain slide-in panel without dragging use Sheet; for a centered modal use Dialog.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: One-time-passcode input on input-otp with individual slots, a blinking fake caret, active-slot ring and aria-invalid danger styling. Exports InputOTP, InputOTPGroup, InputOTPSlot, InputOTPSeparator.
items.docs: Set maxLength to the code length and group slots with InputOTPGroup; InputOTPSeparator draws a divider between groups. Read the value from onChange.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: Date calendar on react-day-picker v10 styled with ai2 Button and tokens. Single, multiple and range selection, dropdown or label caption, outside days, week numbers. Exports Calendar, CalendarDayButton.
items.docs: Pass mode single/multiple/range with selected + onSelect. captionLayout=dropdown adds month/year dropdowns. For a popover-triggered field use DatePicker.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: Date field that opens a Calendar in a Popover. Controlled or uncontrolled via value/defaultValue and onValueChange; formats the selected date with date-fns and shows a placeholder when empty.
items.docs: Single-date picker composed from Calendar + Popover + Button. Read the value from onValueChange; pass defaultValue for uncontrolled use.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Right-click menu on radix-ui with items, checkbox and radio items, submenus, labels, separators and shortcuts. Item variant default or danger. Icons work with lucide svg and remixicon i. Exports the full ContextMenu part set.
items.docs: Wrap the target in ContextMenuTrigger; the menu opens on right-click. Use variant=danger on destructive items. Mirrors DropdownMenu but for contextual actions.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: Application menu bar on radix-ui with top-level menus, items, checkbox and radio items, submenus, labels, separators and shortcuts. Item variant default or danger. Icons work with lucide svg and remixicon i. Exports the full Menubar part set.
items.docs: Use for desktop-style File/Edit/View menus across the top of an app. Each MenubarMenu holds a MenubarTrigger + MenubarContent. Use variant=danger on destructive items.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Resizable split panels on react-resizable-panels with horizontal or vertical groups and an optional drag handle. Exports ResizablePanelGroup, ResizablePanel, ResizableHandle.
items.docs: Set direction on ResizablePanelGroup (horizontal/vertical), size each ResizablePanel with defaultSize, and separate them with ResizableHandle (withHandle shows a grip).

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Slider/carousel on embla-carousel-react with horizontal or vertical orientation, keyboard support and prev/next controls built from ai2 Button. Exports Carousel, CarouselContent, CarouselItem, CarouselPrevious, CarouselNext.
items.docs: Wrap slides in CarouselItem inside CarouselContent; set basis on items for multi-slide views. Pass opts for embla options and plugins for autoplay. setApi exposes the embla api.
